rules.shared: Weather acceptance needs a scoped owner integration or evidence
rules.inherited: Platform-owned dependency; verify relevance and disclose missing proof without widening Weather implementation

standards.required_evidence: Prove admitted DB/API placement across physical host failure domains and isolated single-host loss behavior; record NAS capture/media outage dependency and service tier.
Map actual durable copies and independent failure domains; no unsupported node pinning. RF1 archive blocks and NFS staging do not become HA because database replicas exist.
Record dependency recovery for GitOps, DNS and monitoring; consume owner proof or report its absence. Weather does not redeploy shared controllers.
Validate single-replica drain policy and operator-supported database PDB behavior; capture writer replacement still requires fencing.
Reference owner power-order/flush evidence; document outage/restart dependencies. No live household power drill in this planning pass.

Enumerate every retained data class, three independent copies, two media, offsite immutable/offline custody and full verification. Separate ephemeral dense capture/preview exceptions from durable history.
Read back actual offsite key capabilities, scope and Object Lock/retention; test denied destructive actions through approved qualification. Never distribute management keys to application pods.
Weather-owned Barman plugin base/WAL objects, fresh successful base and contiguous recoverable WAL; logical exports alone are insufficient.
Scheduled isolated semantic restore with achieved RPO/RTO, checkpoint closure/hash proof and stale-drill alerts. Recovery runs without original storage or inference.
Resolve recovery configuration, identities and decryption keys without original Mac/NAS/DB; verify independent escrow and cold readback, not merely a file on this Mac.
Delivered rules cover pods/jobs/replicas, PVC/node pressure, clock/freshness and missing series; rule tests plus live nonempty evaluation.
Separate base/WAL/media/joint ages and failures, missing receipts and expired silences; each producer maps to owner/runbook.
Define denominators, error budgets and multiwindow request SLO burn; separately measure completed capture/publication work and stale data.
Probe the actual public origin and representative eligible media; distinguish route, dependency and data freshness failures.
Resolvable runbooks and impact-based severity; verify existing receiver routing through owner workflow. No outbound product notification feature is added.
Verify sanitized Weather logs reach retained central logging with bounded volume; no raw packet, credential, private note or model-response logging by default.
Restricted namespace/default seccomp and workload security checks; audit logging is inherited owner evidence, not a new Weather cluster-admin permission.
Least-privilege roles and no automatic API token where unnecessary; negative can-i/access tests, no broad Secret listing or long-lived service-account tokens.
Nonroot/unprivileged pods; any UDP/GPU host attachment requires exact supported owner exception and isolation qualification, not blanket hostNetwork.
Default-deny ingress and explicit bounded egress; collector can contact only assigned camera. Node-managed NFS is separately documented and tested.
All running containers/init containers use admitted local registry digests; verify actual image IDs, mirror coverage and offline core startup.
Reference owning platform's at-rest key cadence and recovery evidence; do not rotate or revoke credentials as an incidental Weather action.

Record exact public read-only route disposition including read-only search POST; private operator/diagnostic routes require authenticated authorized access with MFA-backed identity and negative tests.
No public provider/catalog/archive/raw/diagnostic bypass; bound request sizes/rates and sanitize errors. Public requests never trigger camera capture.
Weather workload egress cannot reach unrelated management planes; inherited management MFA/SSH remediation stays with platform owners.
Verify repository secret scanning/push protection/vulnerability alerts and least-privilege app installation; review dependency updates without enabling untrusted access to fleet credentials.
Actual origin TLS/HSTS and response-header readback; narrow framing exception only on embed route, with private routes denied framing.
Before deploying a branch, verify PR/required automatically triggered checks and no standing bypass against the fleet baseline; do not invent a required status with no producer.
One check entrypoint on supported registry-driven fleet submission; reconcile baseline ARC wording with current native event path; foreign-fork exclusion is not safe untrusted CI.
Observe exact-SHA main checks, success/cancellation history and under-15-minute standard target; isolate slower qualified experiments from normal validation without skipping critical tests.
Bind image SBOM/signature/provenance and full-SHA action pins to running digest; verify admission policy and failure on invalid provenance, not merely attach a build artifact.
Reference scheduled platform conformance and stale-run signal; add Weather-specific scheduled drift/restore obligations through owners rather than duplicate cluster-wide jobs.
Desired state and named controller ownership come from Git; verify managed fields, with migrations/jobs using supported scoped operations rather than manual Argo overrides.
Weather application at intended revision is Synced/Healthy with correct digest and no unexplained prune/orphan state; then verify product behavior.
Weather Application/AppProject is parented by existing agents roots; declaration, tracking identity and namespace boundaries match.
Owner Git declares NAS/network/DNS grants; apply via supported idempotent paths and verify drift, not hand-created unmanaged infrastructure.
Version support and vulnerability/patch policy cover shipped runtime, media codecs and DB/extensions; shared host/kernel work remains owner-managed.
Version register/update detection records exact image/library/codec/extension/schema/model-profile identities and compatibility/qualification status.
Track certificate/domain/identity deadlines with adequate warning and owned renewal; expired identity must not trigger anonymous fallback.
Reference platform etcd maintenance and capacity evidence; Weather cannot administer etcd.
Admit actual scheduler/storage/N-1 headroom, runway and bounded write growth; normal below-80% target is distinct from emergency stop watermarks. No intensive Mac fallback.
Every container/init/experiment declares bounded CPU/memory requests and memory limit, concurrency and deadline; prove workload fit against live admission.
Weather namespace ownership label, quota and LimitRange come from central ownership/admission contract and match readback.
Disposable job/replica/CI state expires through supported lifecycle; retained logs/receipts/data and recovery references are preserved, not swept with job TTL.
One current owner per resource, one secret lane, central record plus owner inventory, scoped routes/certs and actual monitoring renderer; reconcile archived site owner before embed.
Reuse supported Barman plugin, registry mirrors and CNPG metrics; verify real installed compatibility rather than copying legacy syntax.
